title: Derivative Calculator
description: Symbolic differentiation of polynomials, sin/cos/tan, exp, ln and sqrt with genuine step-by-step rules: power, product, quotient and chain rule.
howto: Type a function of x, e.g. 3*x^2 + sin(x) - 5*ln(x). Use * for multiplication and ^ for powers.
Press Differentiate to get f′(x) computed by real symbolic rules.
Read the steps: each term shows which rule was applied (power, product, quotient, chain).
Supported: polynomials, x^n, sin, cos, tan, exp, ln, sqrt, products and quotients.

faqs.a: Write multiplication with * (3*x), powers with ^ (x^2), and functions as sin(x), cos(x), tan(x), exp(x), ln(x), sqrt(x). Parentheses group as usual.
The expression is parsed into a tree, then the power rule, product rule, quotient rule and chain rule are applied recursively — the same rules taught in calculus — and the result is simplified.

faqs.q: Why does the answer look unsimplified sometimes?
faqs.a: The tool applies only safe algebraic simplifications (removing ×1, +0, folding constants). Factoring or trig identities are left as-is so every step stays verifiable.
